Recoil Bound.name: Recoil Bound
Recoil Bound.description: The user fires at clear ground behind or below them, using the recoil to cross a gap up to five meters or slow a fall from one story before landing. The shot still strikes the ground, so the user needs an empty impact area and a clear landing. It cannot stop a longer fall, and the user cannot fire again before landing. Strain: moderate.
